selection_criteria: The 80 most recently published GitHub-reviewed advisories for the pip ecosystem as of 2026-08-07, capped at 2 per source repository and 1 per fixing commit, restricted to those carrying a CWE and a fixing-commit reference into their own repository whose parent is not a merge, whose fix diff is under 400 KB, and which touch reviewable Python source outside tests and docs. Ground-truth spans are the lines the fix removed, excluding spans that are entirely imports, version bumps or comments. Two fixing commits were then excluded by hand as bulk refactors whose spans mark remediation plumbing rather than the defect; the reasons are in benchmark/corpus/labelled-excluded.txt. NOT filtered by CWE: classes no 3a detector can emit are retained and reported as a stratum. Newest-first sampling makes the set post-cutoff for any model evaluated later.

AIOHTTP: HTTP request smuggling via WebSocket upgrade

findings.title: Upgrade requests with a body are switched to raw tail immediately, skipping body parsing

evidence.why: self._upgraded is now set as soon as headers with a supported Upgrade are parsed, and the request-body payload creation is gated with 'and not self._upgraded', so any Content-Length/chunked body on the upgrade request is no longer read into a payload; instead the parser stops consuming HTTP semantics and everything after the headers (including the actual body bytes) is treated as opaque upgraded-protocol tail data returned to the caller. A rejected/declined upgrade handler that calls request.read() will get an empty/incorrect body while the real body bytes leak into the connection's tail, potentially desynchronizing request framing on keep-alive connections (request smuggling risk) since downstream code assumes the tail starts a new HTTP message.

remediation.summary: Review the flagged construct and apply the tool's guidance for this rule.

findings.title: C parser also switches protocols before the request body is read, removing RFC 9110 §7.8-15 deferral

evidence.why: The removed _pending_upgrade mechanism used to delay cb_on_headers_complete's return value until the body was fully consumed; now self._upgraded is set immediately on seeing a supported Upgrade header (or CONNECT), and cb_on_headers_complete returns 2 right away, causing llhttp to stop parsing the body. This reintroduces the request-smuggling-adjacent issue the deleted CHANGES/13016.bugfix.rst entry says was fixed: a rejected WebSocket upgrade's body is no longer read by the framework, so a handler's request.read() sees no body while unread body bytes get treated as upgraded-protocol data instead of being cleanly separated.

remediation.summary: Review the flagged construct and apply the tool's guidance for this rule.

advisory.summary: AIOHTTP: HTTP request smuggling via WebSocket upgrade

findings.title: Client WebSocket reader no longer pins compress to negotiated value
